'''Membrosia''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage made by the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[membrosia giver]]s. [[Gold membrosia]] was especially favored by [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|races]]. The [[Gorog]] formed their own version called [[Membrosia/Legends|black membrosia]], which was much more powerful and more addictive. After a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Black market/Legends|black market]] sales, it had ruined the economy of the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]]. [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] [[Supreme Commander]] [[Sien Sovv]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] drunk on black membrosia crashed into his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Joiner]] [[Vector Hyllus]] once bestowed a gift of [[White membrosia/Legends|white membrosia]] to a fellow [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] operative.

Membrosia was available at the [[Soft Heart Cantina]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] through unknown means.
